name: Coursed rubble stone panel
parts: roughly squared oolitic limestone rubble in irregular courses
larger levelling stones at course breaks
recessed lime mortar bed and perpends
lichen and soot staining on weathered stones
summary: Cotswold coursed rubble wall panel, 1.2 m: roughly squared honey oolitic limestone in irregular courses, recessed lime mortar, through-stones and lichen.
